crescent_single_thick.note: main single crescent, thick middle, tapered tips

crescent_single_thin.note: thin filament crescent for layering or quick jabs

ground_ring.note: flat closed annulus for ground shock rings (u around, v radial)

crescent_single_thick_hd.note: crescent_single_thick with 72 segments: smooth outline at 8+ stud radius (SlashSweep, wave 2)

crystal.note: hexagonal ice prism, flat facets, 1 x 1 stud, length along Y in Roblox (IceExplosion spikes)

ice_mound.note: low faceted icy mound (1 stud wide) to bed spike bases in (IceExplosion)
